title: Skill front matter
description: The YAML front matter of skills/<name>/SKILL.md (SKL-1, docs/capabilities.md). Only the name, the description and an optional license and version; the field allowed-tools and any other field fail the schema. The name equals the folder name. The rest of the folder (only SKILL.md, references/ and assets/, text files within the size limit, no executable files) is checked by the apply lint, not by this schema.

name.description: Skill name; equals the folder name skills/<name>/.

description.description: Short description the model sees before it reads the skill; the same text as in the role skill-ref.

license.description: License id of the skill text, for example AGPL-3.0-only.

version.description: Version of the skill text for people; the role pins the skill by its tree hash, not by this field.
